The '''Starswoop Biker's Fair''' was an annual show held in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Ostensibly for [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], some [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] were also shown as well. The [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bike]] was a highlight of the show.<ref name="GG7" />
